Artifact-contract evidence is overstated: qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260515_002 is absent, qepm/mailbox/.../weights.csv is absent, covariance.parquet is absent, and sr_provenance_certificate.issued=false. Stage B covariance_rolling passes PSD/cond, but that is not the exact contract the judge claims is clean.

AX-008 is directionally corroborated but not quorum-clean: Architect is not spawned, Codex is a critic not own-PASS, and Forge remains artifact-incomplete. Judge should record AX-008 as FAIL/INSUFFICIENT for archival completeness, even though REJECT execution can proceed.

The mandated 5-spec statistical pack remains incomplete for the blend. CAPM/Carhart-3/Carhart-4/FF5/FF6 are deferred or substituted, so Harvey/DSR robustness should be described as sufficient for rejection, not as a complete Gate PASS.
